reel.caption:
Missed your ITR deadline? You can still file until 31 December.

A belated return for this year can be filed until 31 Dec 2026.
The late fee is ₹1,000 if your total income is up to ₹5 lakh, and up to ₹5,000 above that.
If tax is still unpaid, interest of 1% a month runs on it as well.

What stopped you from filing on time?

Sources: two personal-finance news sites (Sep and Oct 2026) and a tax-filing explainer on belated-return penalties.

For education only. Not investment advice.
